'''Thrassk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] who became an influential [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] clan leader. During the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Ruusan campaign|Battle of Ruusan]], Thrassk worked with the clan leaders [[Teesoo]], [[Saya Ksi]] and [[Keekrim Pon]] to re-found the defunct [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] of old as the "New Bounty Hunters Guild." Thrassk and the other leaders collectively developed the [[Bounty Hunters' Creed]], the guiding principles of the new Guild, and to appease the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], they came up with proposals as to how the Guild and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] could work together.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
